network_status.network: SP28 Panoramica di Enna - cronologia dei crolli 2009 e 2015
network_status.summary_it: Il crollo del febbraio 2009 sulla SP28 Panoramica interessa un tratto stradale e due arcate in un contesto di frana dopo piogge, non un attraversamento fluviale con una sezione idrometrica identificata. ARCUS non attribuisce un colmo a un dissesto di versante.
network_status.summary_en: The February 2009 SP28 Panoramica collapse affected a road section and two arches in a landslide setting after rainfall, not a river crossing with an identified gauge section. ARCUS assigns no peak to a slope-instability failure.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
